senses.gloss:
श्लोक्(ऋ)श्लोकृ r. 1st. cl. (श्लोकते)
 1. To put together, to compose, as
verses.
 2. To heap together.
 3. To acquire.
 4. To relinquish.

श्लोक m. (-कः)
 1. A verse, a stanza.
 2. A stanza written in Anush-
[]
ṭubh metre.
 3. Praising, praise.
 4. An object of praise.
 5. A pro-
verb, a saying.
 6. Fame, celebrity.
 E. श्लोक् to compose, (as verses,)
aff. अच्; according to the Rāmāyaṇa, irrly. derived from शोक
sorrow: the first verse ever composed, having been the involun-
tary expression of VĀLMĪKI'S grief at beholding a bird killed
by a fowler.

श्लोकत्व n. (-त्वं) Versification.
 E. त्व added to the last.
श्लोण्(ऋ)श्लोणृ r. 1st cl. (श्लोणति) To heap together, to collect or assemble.
